name: Skills Lab: /skills opens the editor of the first skill; tabs, stats and community search
description: Loads /skills, which opens the skill editor of the first seeded skill on its default Preview tab (no separate list page: the editor shows the skill list on the left). Picks another seeded skill in that list, checks the block the agent receives, the agent linking it (Config), the usage stats and the version history, then opens the community search drawer from Add skill (no search is typed, so no GitHub call). Read-only: nothing is saved. Section labels are upper-cased by CSS and agent-browser matches rendered text, so the steps wait on texts without text-transform; clicks target role-bearing elements (cards are role=button, tabs and menu items are buttons).
